result.text:
# CobaltLake 5.1 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 5.1, snapshot retention is 42 calendar days (retention_days=42).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

# CobaltLake 5.1 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of CobaltLake release 5.1.
The default checkpoint interval is 15 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=15).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 8 (max_parallel_imports=8).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

Community background note. This reference describes the default deployment profile. Storage retention, checkpoint scheduling, and import concurrency are separate configuration concepts. result.title: CobaltLake: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# CobaltLake glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
